select.if:
SELECT ftl.flow_id,ftl.template_id,ftl.cur_link,ftl.link_type,ftl.pre_link,ftl.next_link,flc.link_name,flic.msg_notify_type,flic.role_id,flic.notify_admin_flag,flic.leader_flag,'2' as userType FROM vm_flow_template_link ftl INNER JOIN vm_flow_link_config flc ON ftl.cur_link = flc.link_id LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_industry_config flic ON ftl.cur_link = flic.link_id
AND flic.industry_code is null
WHERE ftl.delete_flag = 0
AND flic.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND flic.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} AND flic.delete_flag = '0'
and ftl.template_id = #{templateId}
AND ftl.cur_link = #{linkId}
AND ftl.real_link_type = #{realLinkType} and ftl.link_type='1'

mapper.select: select distinct template_id from vm_flow_template_industry where template_id = #{templateId} and industry_code = #{industryCode} AND app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} AND delete_flag = '0' AND status = '1'

SELECT ft.template_id,ft.tenant_id,ft.flow_name,ft.init_source,fti.app_ver_code,fti.industry_code FROM vm_flow_template_industry fti INNER JOIN vm_flow_template ft ON fti.template_id = ft.template_id WHERE fti.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} AND fti.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND fti.warning_source like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{warningSource}),'%') AND fti.delete_flag = 0 AND fti.status = '1'
